intro:
What Does Space Smell Like?!
Become a Space Expert Through Fun Quizzes
description:
Discover surprising facts about space through fun and engaging quiz challenges!

・Which planet rotates the fastest?
・What existed before the Sun was born?
・What does outer space smell like?

Learn fascinating space trivia that you’ll be excited to share with friends.

Complete all the quizzes and earn your place as a true space expert!

The game also includes a helpful Hint feature, making it enjoyable for players of all knowledge levels.

Looking for a fun and easy way to learn about space in your spare time? This game is a great place to start.

Recommended for people who:
・Love space and astronomy
・Want to expand their knowledge
・Enjoy testing themselves
・Like brain-training games while passing the time
・Dream of becoming an astronaut

※This game is designed to be played on the Nintendo Switch™ in vertical orientation.
